purpose: Determine whether a statistically fresh train-only V71 gate exists and whether ensemble-copula coupling can preserve the V63 one-point marginal by construction, without implementing a candidate or opening development/EAGLE.

invalid_followup_routes.reuse_the_V70_sixteen_query_gate: invalid for V71 selection because its TNG100 tail outcome informed the proposed marginal-preserving change
invalid_followup_routes.select_new_queries_from_V70_fit_objects: invalid because their target fields contributed to V70 optimization
invalid_followup_routes.use_signed_isometries_as_new_objects: invalid because augmentation does not create independent target realizations
invalid_followup_routes.open_V70_development_under_the_rejected_: forbidden by the sealed V70 branch

ensemble_copula_coupling_property.candidate_rank_source: for each query, voxel, and fixed ensemble, rank the V70 spatial-score latent samples across members
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.marginal_value_source: at the identical query and voxel, sort the paired independent standard-normal V63-control latent values across members
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.coupling: assign the sorted marginal values according to the candidate member ranks
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.exact_finite_ensemble_invariant: the coupled and independent-control latent multisets are identical separately at every query and voxel
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.one_point_consequence: any statistic pooled over members at a fixed conditioning-defined voxel mask is exactly identical to the independent V63-control statistic before floating-point roundoff
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.joint_structure_consequence: the empirical cross-voxel member-rank copula is inherited from the V70 spatial candidate
ensemble_copula_coupling_property.reason_not_yet_a_candidate: The construction is mathematically feasible but has not been implemented, sampled, or evaluated, and no statistically valid automatic selection gate remains in the consumed train partition.

path_A.description: obtain genuinely new untouched simulation objects, freeze a V71 program and fresh train-only gate, then retain the current development and EAGLE seals

path_B.description: with explicit approval, freeze V71 ECC and a new single-use development program before opening the still-unseen development selections; use the consumed V70 gate only as model-development evidence, never as V71 selection evidence
